title: モンキーレンチ
description: 公共施設の保守工具棚や整備台に置く調整式レンチ。開いた固定顎と可動顎、ラック歯と固定したウォーム状調整ねじ、柄の補強面、実際に開いた吊下げ穴を造形。目盛や締結物はなく、一つの顎開度で固定されています。調整・締付け機能や実用品の強度・精度は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.062 × 0.022 × 0.252 m、4,084三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An adjustable wrench for public-facility tool racks and maintenance benches, with separated fixed/sliding jaws, rack teeth, a fixed worm-like adjuster, raised handle rib and real hanging hole. No scale or fastener is included; the jaw remains at one opening. Adjustment, tightening, real strength and precision are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.062 × 0.022 × 0.252 m; 4,084 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
